{{Quote|A recipe I created for the ninth Count. My gentlebeings have been so good as to commend it warmly these last eight generations.|Fidelis explains the history of Crêpes Malreaux|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of [[House Malreaux]] served as the ninth [[Count/Legends|count]] in the history of the house, which was one of the richest families on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. Whilst he was count, the individual owned the [[FIII Footman droid]] [[Fidelis]] who created the recipe for the dish known as [[Crêpes Malreaux]] for him and continued to serve it for his family long after the count's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Y:DR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The count was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' which was written by [[Sean Stewart]] and released in [[2004]].
